headline: Dutch Government to Oppose US Plans Restricting ASML Sales to China
summary: The Dutch government stated it will oppose US plans to restrict semiconductor equipment manufacturer ASML's sales to China, viewing pending legislative proposals as a threat to the company.
why: ASML is a critical global supplier of photolithography systems essential for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

impacts.name: ASML Holding
impacts.why: Government opposition to foreign sales restrictions protects market access and export revenues for the chip equipment maker.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
